# Newport Smog & Auto Registration

> STAR certified, test-only smog check station and auto registration (DMV) services in Costa Mesa, California. BAR # ARD 269691. Established in 2001.

## Contact and location
- Address: 375 Bristol St, Unit 80, Costa Mesa, CA 92626, USA
- Phone: (714) 436-1700
- Email: newportsmog@gmail.com
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=9976886115007903729
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Newport+Smog+%26+Auto+Registration,+375+Bristol+St+Unit+80,+Costa+Mesa,+CA+92626

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services
- STAR test-only smog checks (test only, no repairs, so no repair upsell)
- Smog checks for vehicles from 1976 to the present: gasoline, diesel, CNG and hybrid; cars, vans, SUVs, trucks and RVs
- Luxury, high-performance and exotic car smog inspections
- Auto registration and DMV services: renewals, title transfers, non-resident transfers, duplicate titles, plates, registrations and stickers
- VIN verification
- Dealer and fleet smog checks
- Quotes: call (714) 436-1700 or stop by.
